reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct diagnosis (mould/biofilm in the drawer, seal and filter), had the customer inspect the right spots, advised unplugging before the filter, and gave the right remedy: clean the drawer housing and seal fold and run a hot maintenance wash, with no unjustified part or engineer call. Its weaknesses were an initial misdirection toward condenser/drying capacity and never asking about wash temperature, softener use or leaving the door open. Conversation 2 refused to engage at all on a plainly non-safety, user-fixable problem and pushed an unnecessary engineer visit, offering the homeowner nothing.
